summary: Bristow Group Inc. files Form 8-K announcing entry into a definitive Merger Agreement to acquire Berry Aviation for $105 million in cash, subject to working capital and other adjustments. The transaction will be effected via a merger of a wholly owned subsidiary (Merger Sub) with Berry Acquisition, with Berry Aviation as the target. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal. Bristow obtained a conditional representation and warranty insurance policy. Closing conditions are customary; the transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026. No per-share price, premium, or break fee was disclosed; the cash consideration and expected H2 2026 timeline are the key terms. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder approvals.
